name: id-usability-test-plan
description: Usability-test plan gate (interaction-design methodology, phase 2 record). Requires the phase-2 interaction-design record to name at least one task scenario plus a participant-count/recruitment line before it is judged complete. Planned, not conducted: this plugin only enforces that a usability test is planned — actually running or reporting a real usability test is phase 3+ and out of scope. use_when: judging the phase-2 docs/issue-<n>/reports/interaction-design.md record, alongside the other id-* phase-2 plugins per the interaction-design gate-machine proposal.
